# cycle_hub (Data Source)

Retrieves information about the Cycle hub the provider is configured for (`/v1/hubs/current`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the hub the provider is configured for.
data "cycle_hub" "current" {}

output "hub_name" {
  value = data.cycle_hub.current.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the hub.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slug identifier of the hub.
- `name` (String) The name of the hub.
- `state` (String) The current state of the hub (e.g. `live`).
